name: API Security Researcher
description: API discovery, protocol reverse-engineering, JavaScript security code review, and request export.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https: http: data:; frame-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'
